scope: One bounded crate/API standards source pass; not full architecture audit completion.
runtime_execution: None. No Cargo, test, network, Docker, push or merge.

findings.problem: Shared request types have request-module paths plus protocol aliases. SourceBinding has module/root paths. Shared TLS error types have multiple protocol paths. This conflicts with the supplied canonical-path standard; no compatibility requirement is documented in the read source.
findings.recommendation: Make request canonical for shared request types. Keep root SourceBinding/InvalidSourceBinding and hide implementation module after retaining its platform guidance. Give TlsError/TlsErrorKind/EchFailure one root path before removing protocol aliases. Preserve distinct Http1TlsError/Http2TlsError wrappers. Migrate callers/docs and inventories without runtime changes.

findings.problem: Most settings have root and public-module aliases; QUIC types, TCP bounds and hidden hint placement are currently module-only. Hiding modules without preserving these names breaks actual cross-crate consumers.
findings.recommendation: Root canonical settings is coherent with existing imports. Reexport the 12 QUIC names and five TCP constants before making non-browser modules private. Retain the three hidden hint-placement items at one hidden seam. Keep browser recipes public; migrate callers/docs and regenerate inventories.

findings.problem: No-global-runtime claim contradicts the intentional process-lifetime Tokio deadline service in net, also used by the facade prune timer.
findings.recommendation: Describe caller Tokio I/O and the separate shared deadline runtime accurately. Keep no tracing-subscriber installation. Do not change runtime implementation in this scope.

no_findings_by_bounded_contract.Dependency direction: All six manifests show an acyclic runtime graph: facade -> net/profile; net -> profile/QUIC provider; provider -> profile; profile -> no dependencies; testkit -> Tokio. Testkit references are dev-dependencies only.
no_findings_by_bounded_contract.Crate split: Keep all five boundaries. Dependency-free profiles, raw transport capture consumers, custom Quinn crypto composition, and independent testkit capture consumers are real needs. No further split/merge/extraction has a demonstrated consumer or build justification in this pass; size alone is insufficient.
no_findings_by_bounded_contract.Feature gates: Facade default is empty; full excludes diagnostics/danger; JSON/serde, cookies, SSE, WS/deflate and HTTPS root exports match manifest gates. H3 qlog options/exports are guarded. Not a complete implementation or compilation audit.
no_findings_by_bounded_contract.FFI separation: Only private backend and socket_ffi declarations carry audited unsafe exceptions. Packet/header primitives are private; Quinn trait consumers require their implementations. Safe btls contexts and Quinn traits in the low-level provider are intentional public dependencies, used by actual ECH server capture composition. No raw pointer facade export found. Backend descendants/platform FFI bodies were not fully reread.
no_findings_by_bounded_contract.Facade reexports: Facade is an intentional consumer entry point, distinct from redundant aliases within one crate. It exposes typed profile configuration and wrapped certificate/auth types. Hidden run_after and client-hint placement are real cross-crate seams and cannot be culled as unused.
no_findings_by_bounded_contract.Concrete ownership: Private facade/provider modules and concrete protocol domains match the read consumers. No speculative framework or size-based extraction is recommended.
